topics.label: Lecture introduction and cancer hallmarks overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer frames the session by outlining the learning objectives, tumor progression models, and the cancer hallmarks framework.

topics.label: Deregulation of proliferative growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations deregulate upstream receptor signaling cascades, specifically Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinases, to drive continuous proliferation.

topics.label: Differentiation block in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how failure to undergo terminal lineage differentiation contributes to malignancy in hematopoietic diseases and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and alterations in the mitochondrial apoptotic pathway.

topics.label: Replicative immortalization, senescence, and stress signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere maintenance, TERT reactivation, and p53-mediated senescence responses regulate cellular lifespan, concluding the discussion of growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Altered cellular metabolism and metabolic rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the Warburg effect, tissue-specific metabolic profiles, and oncometabolites that drive cancer progression.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the necessity and timing of new blood vessel recruitment to supply growing tumors with oxygen and nutrients.

topics.label: Mechanisms, inefficiency, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the multistep cascade of systemic tumor dissemination, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, and genomic findings from metastatic sequencing.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session by reviewing key concepts, recommending further reading, and closing with housekeeping.
